title: AI for Business and Office Work
introduction: This lesson shows how simple AI tools can help with everyday business tasks such as writing documents, summarizing meetings, communicating with customers, creating reports, and preparing presentations.

sections.heading: AI for Drafting Documents
sections.subheading: How AI can create first drafts quickly
paragraphs: AI writing assistants can generate a basic version of letters, proposals, or contracts based on a short prompt.
You only need to add specific details and review the text for accuracy.

example.title: Drafting a Project Proposal
example.content: You type: “Write a one‑page project proposal for a new marketing campaign targeting young adults.” The AI returns a structured draft that you can edit and finalize.

sections.heading: AI for Meeting Summaries
sections.subheading: Turning spoken notes into clear minutes
paragraphs: After a meeting, you can upload the audio or paste the transcript into an AI tool.
The AI extracts key points, decisions, and action items into a concise summary.

example.title: Summarizing a Team Call
example.content: You paste the meeting transcript and the AI produces a bullet‑point list of decisions, responsible persons, and deadlines.

sections.heading: AI in Customer Communication
paragraphs: AI can suggest replies to common customer questions, keeping the tone professional.
It helps maintain quick response times without sacrificing quality.

example.title: Responding to a Support Query
example.content: A customer asks about a delayed shipment. You give the AI the query and key details; it drafts a courteous response explaining the delay and next steps.

sections.heading: AI for Data Analysis and Reporting
sections.subheading: Turning raw numbers into simple insights
paragraphs: You can feed sales data or survey results into an AI model.
The AI highlights trends, creates short explanations, and suggests visual charts.

example.title: Weekly Sales Report
example.content: You upload a CSV of sales figures. The AI writes a brief report noting the top‑selling product, a dip in region X, and recommends a promotion.

sections.heading: AI for Presentations and Workflow
paragraphs: AI can generate slide outlines from a topic and suggest bullet points.
It can also suggest next steps for a workflow, such as reminders or task assignments.

example.title: Creating a Pitch Deck
example.content: You ask the AI to outline a 5‑slide pitch for a new app. It provides slide titles, key points, and a short speaker note for each slide.

practice.title: Practice: Draft an Email with AI Help
practice.instruction: Use a free AI writing tool to compose a short professional email requesting a meeting with a client. Review the AI’s suggestions and make any needed changes.

keyTakeaways: AI can quickly create first drafts of business documents, saving time.
AI tools turn meeting recordings into clear, actionable summaries.
AI helps write consistent customer replies, generate simple reports, and build presentation outlines.

mcqs.question: After an AI writing assistant creates a first draft of a project proposal, what should you do next?
options: Send the draft directly to the client
Add specific details and review the text for accuracy
Translate the draft into another language
Delete the draft and start over
mcqs.explanation: The lesson says you need to add specific details and check the draft for correctness before finalizing.

mcqs.question: Which item is NOT typically produced by an AI tool when summarizing a meeting transcript?
options: A full verbatim transcript of the meeting
mcqs.explanation: AI extracts key points, decisions, and action items, not the complete verbatim transcript.

mcqs.question: How does AI assist in customer communication according to the lesson?
options: By generating polite, consistent replies quickly
mcqs.explanation: The lesson highlights that AI suggests courteous replies, keeping tone professional and response time fast.

mcqs.question: When you feed sales data into an AI model for reporting, which of the following can you expect the AI to produce?
options: Identification of trends and suggested visual charts
Source code for a mobile application
mcqs.explanation: The AI highlights trends, writes short explanations, and recommends visual charts for the data.

mcqs.question: In the example of creating a pitch deck, what does the AI provide?
options: Slide titles, key points, and short speaker notes
mcqs.explanation: The AI outlines a 5‑slide pitch by giving titles, bullet points, and brief speaker notes for each slide.
